Three reads

Trade sets the level, place sets the spread

The all-trades map spans roughly 44% to 67% women across districts. Scrub to Domestic & care and the whole country turns teal (92% women); Construction & mining turns it orange (27%). The within-trade spread lives in each district's panel.

States

Women among registrants, by state and trade

Each row is a state; columns are the seven trade groups; colour is the female share on the same parity scale as the graph. Grey means fewer than 1,000 registrations in that cell.
